There are 392 days between the release of OpenAI's GPT-5 and the launch of GPT-6 Astra. GPT-5 was released on August 7, 2025, while GPT-6 Astra officially debuted on September 3, 2026.[1][2]

## GPT-5 Release
OpenAI introduced GPT-5 on August 7, 2025. Upon its release, it replaced GPT-4o and other earlier reasoning models as the default AI system powering ChatGPT.[1]

## GPT-6 Astra Launch
GPT-6 Astra was launched just over a year later on September 3, 2026. OpenAI described it as a new generation of intelligence, featuring advanced capabilities in coding, computer use, and cybersecurity. The model initially rolled out to a limited group of organizations, including Business and Pro subscribers, as well as members of OpenAI's cybersecurity-focused Daybreak program.[3][2][4][1]
